packet_dag.terminal_condition: Parent trial/login and IA consistency work is not done until the parent/student journey is audited, safe access/email blockers are explicit, implementation is evidence-backed, and app-visible changes are deployed/live-smoked.

title: Parent Trial Login And Cross-Workspace IA Consistency

reasons: The operator asked for a real parent-style login/welcome flow, parent/student login role split, schedule, library, click tracking, and student password reset.
The request includes external email/access mutation language but lacks exact recipient and class link.
The operator used broad product-quality language around cramped UI, consistency, side panels, categories, subcategories, filters, and toolbar placement.
The request spans Super Admin, Rabbi/provider, parent, student, Agent Mode, Operations drop-off, and release proof.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time parent/member signup and login journey
One Time student login and class/library access journey
Parent portal household, schedule, library, billing/trial, click, and attendance visibility
Operations Super Admin and Rabbi/provider admin shell
Agent Mode audit access and Operations Agent Review drop-off
likely_external_provider_blockers: Exact recipient email is ambiguous in the raw request.
Exact One Time class link is not stated in this turn.
Real access grant or trial/member creation needs confirmation of test versus production scope.
Real email send must use approved copy, recipient, sender, and class link.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Inspect current parent/student access routes and produce navigation-specific Agent Mode prompts before broad UI implementation.

operator_intent_summary: Shloimie wants to experience One Time as a fresh parent receiving a 30-day welcome/login, then verify that parent and student portals, schedule, library, click/attendance tracking, student login reset, and role-specific views work cleanly. He also wants Super Admin, Rabbi/provider, parent, and student interfaces to share the same IA grammar for side panels, categories, top subcategories, filters, and drawers.
raw_quotes: I want to get a login to my email sdrtler as if I was a parent
I need to be able to see the schedule
I need to be able to see the library
tracking the clicks of the students
there should be a parent login and a student login
from the parent login I'm able to reset the student password
I thought we're structuring everything like the BNA super admin viewer
all of those things in the filters across every single workspace is all going to be positioned the same way
make like an agent mode like page as if there was like a student that just doesn't need a password

decisions_captured.decision: Do not send a live parent trial/login email or mutate access until exact recipient, class link, copy, and test-vs-production scope are auditable.
Keep parent and student roles separate in the product model, even if the first audited release shares some underlying data.

out_of_scope: No live email send until exact recipient, copy, class link, sender, and account scope are confirmed.
No Stripe charge, checkout creation, billing mutation, DNS change, WhatsApp/SMS send, provider account write, or legacy CRM write.
No shared real password for Agent Mode, student, parent, Rabbi, or Super Admin.
No broad UI implementation before current-state audit and Definition of Ready.
No staging, reverting, or committing unrelated dirty work.
affected_surfaces: One Time schedule, library, click tracking, and attendance readbacks
Agent Review drop-off and Agent Mode audit test link

inspection_targets: Existing parent access/magic-link API and email-send behavior
Existing student password account API and parent reset/set support
Parent portal sections for schedule, library, trial/billing, click, and attendance visibility
Student portal class/library access and student-safe actions
Operations Super Admin side panel, top subcategories, filters, and drawer placement
Rabbi/provider admin side panel, top subcategories, filters, and drawer placement
Agent Review drop-off route and failure-reporting behavior
known_from_operator: Parent/student UI still feels cramped in some places.
Rabbi/provider view is confusing and appears to be broken into lame or inconsistent categories.
Super Admin layout is closer to the desired grammar.
Agent Mode prompts need exact navigation and failure drop-off behavior.
known_blockers: Exact live email recipient and class link are missing.
No-password Agent Mode walkthrough link must be verified or built before asking agents to audit as real users.
Broad IA fixes are blocked until current-state visual/route evidence exists.

trigger_phrases: lots of buttons and weird stuff
agent mode prompts are not thorough enough

expanded_phrases.completely random parent: Provide a safe test/smoke parent journey that behaves like a new signup without exposing or mutating unrelated real family records.
expanded_phrases.30-day starts now: Welcome/trial state must have exact copy, trial start date, next action, class link, and billing/access implications.
expanded_phrases.see the schedule: Parent/student portal must expose the correct parent-safe or student-safe schedule view, or show a precise blocked/empty state.
expanded_phrases.see the library: Portal must show the correct One Time library/member-library destination, tier gating, and empty/blocked states.
expanded_phrases.tracking the clicks: Student link clicks/class access must be logged or explicitly marked as missing with a proposed first-party event model.
expanded_phrases.parent login and student login: Role split must be explicit: parent manages household/billing/access/attendance; student receives student-safe class/library actions.
expanded_phrases.structured really weird: IA must have predictable category/subcategory/filter placement and no unclear role/view identity.
expanded_phrases.everything needs to be consistent: Across workspaces and roles, shared shell primitives should keep side panel, top tabs/subcategories, filters, and drawers in the same positions.
